sections.title: Common Causes of Water Leaks in Houston TX
sections.subtitle: Why plumbing leaks happen
content: Water leaks can develop because of aging plumbing systems, damaged components, pressure issues and pipe deterioration.

causes.description: Older plumbing systems may develop cracks, corrosion and weak connections over time.

causes.title: High Water Pressure
causes.description: Excessive water pressure can put stress on pipes and plumbing fixtures.

causes.title: Damaged Pipe Connections
causes.description: Loose or damaged connections may allow water to escape.

causes.title: Corrosion
causes.description: Pipe corrosion can create weak areas that eventually lead to leaks.
